mutation.instruction: In T10 change the statute cited for the 7-day withdrawal right to an unrelated article.
mutation.defectiveText: 청약철회는 「전자상거래 등에서의 소비자보호에 관한 법률」 제21조에 따라 7일 이내에 할 수 있습니다.

rationale: The 7-day withdrawal right is Article 17(1) of the E-Commerce Act; Article 21 lists prohibited acts. The citation must resolve to the right article.
